name: Extend Song
description: Makes a song longer: new music before it or after it, in the same style, with the song itself kept as it was.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.label: Description
inputs.description: What the new music should be: genre, mood, instruments, voice. Usually the song's own description.

inputs.name: lyrics
inputs.label: Lyrics
inputs.description: Sung in the new music, with [verse] and [chorus] lines to part it. Empty: no words are given to the model, so the new part may be sung or not.

inputs.name: instrumental
inputs.label: Instrumental
inputs.description: No singing. The lyrics are ignored.

inputs.name: reference
inputs.label: Style reference
inputs.description: A recording whose voice and timbre the song takes. Optional.

inputs.name: before
inputs.label: Seconds before
inputs.description: New music added in front of the song, such as an intro. 0: none. One side at a time: set this or Seconds after.

inputs.name: after
inputs.label: Seconds after
inputs.description: New music added after the song, such as a longer ending. 0: none.

inputs.name: quality
inputs.label: Quality
inputs.description: The file the model makes: mp3 (128 kb/s), mp3-320 (320 kb/s) or lossless (a 24-bit WAV, nothing lost to compression).

inputs.name: adapter
inputs.label: Adapter
inputs.description: A singer or style adapter (LoRA) from the music server's adapters folder. Unset: none. Changing it makes the server reload the model, which takes a moment.

inputs.name: adapter_scale
inputs.label: Adapter strength
inputs.description: How strongly the adapter is applied. 1 is as it was trained; lower is subtler.
